claims.text: THE COUNT IS NOT STABLE ON HIS OWN SITE. His press-conference article states 'I have interviewed more than 160 U.S. Air Force veterans regarding their involvement in UFO incidents at nuclear weapons sites.' His biographical page, opened the same day, states 'To date, Hastings has interviewed more than 150 military veterans.' The board records both figures with their pages rather than a round number, because the count is itself the principal evidence for the scale of the claim.
